description: Mapping of stress areas related to coastal erosion and land movements is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. This map locates the parts of the territory where the standards relating to coastal erosion, prescribed by the Government of Quebec, must apply. Coastal erosion constraint areas include protective strips where various interventions must be regulated. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Constraint, Landslide, Terrain movement, Coastal erosion, Government information. It offers 9 resource(s) in GEOJSON, HTML, SHP, WFS. The portal shows 2026-06-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
